groups.name: Intent argument and validation
groups.rationale: Makes --intent a required argument on start, checking before any git or model work, and adds the intent_missing error code.
groups.watch: The intent_missing error code must exit with code 2 (argument error), and the validation must happen before repository checks so blank intents fail immediately without touching git.

groups.name: Argument parsing and start command implementation
groups.rationale: Refactors the start command argument parser to handle --intent as a repeatable flag, threads intents through StartInput to round creation, and echoes them back in the output.
groups.watch: The scanArgs helper must preserve order for repeating flags and filter blank intents before returning; intents must be passed through to createSession and recorded on the round; the agent must see what was stored in the session summary.

groups.name: Intent storage and round lifecycle
groups.rationale: Records intents on each round as a per-round field and provides a helper to retrieve the current round's intents for display.
groups.watch: Intents are per-round so a later round can state different ones without altering approvals; the currentIntents helper must return an empty array for rounds predating the feature, not undefined.

groups.name: Intent delivery and retrieval via server
groups.rationale: Sends intents in the create session request, stores them on the round, and returns current intents in the session read response.
groups.watch: The server must filter intents to strings in parseCreateSession for forward compatibility with older clients; the currentIntents call in the read handler must reflect the round on screen, not stale state.

groups.name: Documentation and help text
groups.rationale: Updates command help, README and skill description to document --intent as required, repeatable, and the strongest signal to the grouping model.
groups.watch: The help messages must explain that the agent is the only party knowing why the branch exists; the spec must reflect that intent is required and fails before git work.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
